from collections import deque
n=24
seq=[12,7,-7]*8
edges=set()
for i in range(n):
    a=i; b=(i+1)%n
    if a>b: a,b=b,a
    edges.add((a,b))
for i,s in enumerate(seq):
    j=(i+s)%n
    a,b=sorted((i,j))
    edges.add((a,b))
print(n,len(edges))
deg=[0]*n
for u,v in edges:
 deg[u]+=1; deg[v]+=1
print(deg, sorted(set(deg)))
# girth
best=999
bestcycle=None
for start in range(n):
    dist=[-1]*n; par=[-1]*n
    q=deque([start]); dist[start]=0
    while q:
        u=q.popleft()
        for a,b in edges:
            if a==u: w=b
            elif b==u: w=a
            else: continue
            if dist[w]<0:
                dist[w]=dist[u]+1; par[w]=u; q.append(w)
            elif par[u]!=w and par[w]!=u:
                cyc=dist[u]+dist[w]+1
                if cyc<best: best=cyc; bestcycle=(start,u,w)
print('girth',best,bestcycle)
